_readme: Images made by `npm run art` (scripts/art.ts). Add one, run it again: only missing files are made. Delete a file to make it again. Style is added to every prompt.
style: Clean, readable game texture for a stylised low-poly 3D game set on a UK high street. Flat front-on view, no perspective, no frame or border, no watermark, no extra text except what is asked for.

images.name: cover_mira
images.prompt: CD album cover, 2004 indie singer-songwriter debut called "first songs" by Mira. A young woman with an acoustic guitar on a small open-mic stage under warm string lights, slightly grainy film photo. The words "MIRA" and "first songs" in simple lowercase type.

images.name: cover_static
images.prompt: CD album cover, 2004 UK garage-rock band The Static, album "Feedback Summer". Four-piece band playing on a street corner in bright summer sun, cables everywhere, xeroxed punk zine collage style. The words "THE STATIC" and "Feedback Summer".

images.name: cover_kbit
images.prompt: CD album cover, 2004 electronic producer DJ K-Bit, album "Polyphonic". A silver flip phone glowing on a dark blue background with pixel-art sound waves, Y2K chrome style. The words "DJ K-BIT" and "Polyphonic".

images.name: window_2004
images.prompt: The inside of a small independent record shop seen through its front window in 2004: racks of CDs, a few faded band posters, a hand-written 'SALE' card, dusty and a bit empty, warm lamp light.

images.name: window_today
images.prompt: The inside of a busy modern independent record shop seen through its front window today: vinyl and CD racks, framed gold discs on the wall, plants, warm modern lighting, a few customers browsing (seen from behind).

images.name: poster_open_mic
images.prompt: Photocopied 2004 flyer taped to a wall: 'OPEN MIC NIGHT - EVERY SUNDAY - HOLLOW RECORDS', hand-drawn guitar doodle, black ink on yellow paper.

images.name: poster_gig
images.prompt: 2004 gig poster: 'THE STATIC - LIVE - FREE - 2 JULY', bold punk lettering, red and black screen print on newsprint, a bit torn at the corners.

images.name: brick_2004
images.prompt: Seamless tileable texture of an old red-brown brick wall with dirty mortar, evenly lit, front-on, fills the whole image.

images.name: pavement
images.prompt: Seamless tileable texture of grey UK pavement slabs seen from directly above, a few cracks and chewing-gum spots, evenly lit, fills the whole image.

images.name: facade_2004_a
images.prompt: The upper floors of a Victorian terraced shop building on a UK high street in 2004, front-on: red-brown brick, two rows of white sash windows with a few net curtains, a drainpipe, slightly sooty. Fills the whole image edge to edge, flat lighting, painterly hand-made style.

images.name: facade_2004_b
images.prompt: The front of a small 2004 UK high-street shop building, front-on: cream painted render, a faded green shop fascia with no readable words, a striped awning, two upstairs windows. Fills the whole image edge to edge, flat lighting, painterly hand-made style.

images.name: facade_today_a
images.prompt: The upper floors of the same kind of Victorian terraced building on a UK high street today, front-on: cleaned brick painted soft grey, modern dark window frames, a couple of plant pots on the sills. Fills the whole image edge to edge, flat lighting, painterly hand-made style.

images.name: facade_today_b
images.prompt: The front of a modern UK high-street cafe building today, front-on: pale sage-green paint, a large glass shop window with warm light, a simple fascia with no readable words, two upstairs windows. Fills the whole image edge to edge, flat lighting, painterly hand-made style.

images.name: shopfront_boarded
images.prompt: A boarded-up small shop front on a UK high street today, front-on: grey plywood boards over the window, faded fly-posters and a bit of graffiti tagging (no readable words), a rusty shutter. Fills the whole image edge to edge, flat lighting, painterly hand-made style.

images.name: wood
images.prompt: Seamless tileable texture of worn painted wooden planks, soft brown, evenly lit, front-on, fills the whole image.
